# mule-starter state

Generated and maintained by the agents; safe to commit.

- `profile.md` — workspace facts written by `/mule-init`.
- `style-facts.json` — raw measurements behind the house-style files (re-created by `/mule-init`).
- `rulesets/<project>.md` — per-project conventions written by the `mule-ruleset` skill; `rulesets/current.md` points at the active run.
- `memory/lessons.md` — durable gotchas.
- `log.md` — one line per change.
- `installed-at` — install date; `/mule-init` learns style only from files last changed before it.
